title: Why the iPhone keyboard inserts ducking into your texts according to the person who designed it AAPL
text: advertisement Business Why the iPhone keyboard inserts ducking into your texts according to the person who designed it AAPL Details Email You may be part of the majority of Americans who don't use the "f word" in daily life. But the rest of us use profanity to emphasize what we're saying and typing, and we get annoyed when our "ducking" phone autocorrects the swear word into something we didn't mean to type.
